deletion_rule: Nonvendored product/frontend TypeScript, JavaScript, Svelte, Node package metadata, and pnpm surfaces are deletion targets. Rust/Buck2 remains the default. Strict TypeScript may be introduced only as a registered tooling exception when Rust is a poor fit, with pinned runtime/dependencies, Buck2 check authority, no pnpm workspace authority, and a registry row documenting why Rust was rejected.
